rationale: Adds pulp create --ui none (NO_EDITOR in the generated CMakeLists.txt) to the C++ and Rust CLIs, accepts --ui vellum and --ui rmlui only to refuse them until the pulp-vellum editor package exists, adds a UI_MODE_LINE placeholder to the effect, instrument and standalone effect templates, and extends the no-editor link floor fixture to forbid Vellum and RmlUi targets. It changes which editor a generated project requests, not how designs are imported, rendered or packaged; no design-import, Chromium, rendering or packaging authority moves.
